content_sections.heading: About ILBS
content_sections.text: The Institute of Liver & Biliary Sciences is an autonomous society under the Govt. of NCT of Delhi, located at Sector D-1, Vasant Kunj, New Delhi. The post is part of an ICMR-funded project titled "Developing a Culture-Independent Rapid Detection Panel of Bacterial Infection in Ascitic Fluid of Decompensated Liver Cirrhosis and Spontaneous Bacterial Peritonitis". The Project PI is Dr Chhagan Bihari, Professor, Department of Pathology, ILBS, New Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: ILBS has advertised one post of Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical). The funding agency is the Indian Council for Medical Research (ICMR), and the monthly emoluments are as sanctioned by the funding agency. The minimum essential qualification is a Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG degrees. For Engineering/IT/CS, a Four Years Graduate Degree is required. Experience, if any, is considered only after the candidate has the essential educational qualification. The age limit is 35, counted as on the closing date. The notice prints no age relaxation. The pay is Rs. 72,800/- per the notice, made up of Basic Rs.56,000 plus 30% HRA. The notice says the emoluments are as sanctioned by the funding agency. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post.

content_sections.heading: Terms of the Appointment
content_sections.text: The project duration is 3 years. The appointment is on contract basis for 12 months initially. The contract may be extended based on satisfactory performance and/or project duration/availability of funds, whichever is earlier. The position is purely contractual and co-terminus with the project duration. Selected candidates have no claim for regular appointment at ILBS or continuation in other projects.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The duly completed prescribed application form, appended to the notice. Supporting documents for educational qualifications. Supporting documents for work experience. A recent passport size photograph, pasted on the application form. Documentary evidence of category (UR/SC/ST/OBC/Ex-Servicemen) or of PWD status (40% or more disability), if claimed in the form. The form asks for name, date of birth, gender, marital status, postal address, mobile number, e-mail, citizenship details, father's/husband's name, education and work experience details, two references and a signed declaration. Applications in any other format will be rejected without any communication.

content_sections.heading: How the Selection Is Made
content_sections.text: The notice invites eligible candidates to attend a walk-in interview. If a large number of applications are received, further screening based on qualifications and experience may be conducted. The notice does not describe any other stage.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Incomplete, late or unsigned applications will be rejected. No TA/DA will be payable for attending the interview or any related process. No other benefits such as Provident Fund, CCA, Leave Travel Concession or Medical Claims will be provided. Canvassing or any attempt to influence the selection process will result in disqualification. Wrong or false information submitted during selection will disqualify the candidature at any stage. The institute reserves the right to cancel the advertised post(s) without assigning any reason. For enquiries, email [email protected] .
